attributes.text: Profiles, profile posts, Stories and Highlights stay open, as do your Saved, Liked and Reposted lists. You can watch one Reel you open and use its comments; swiping to the next one takes you back.

attributes.text: Profile posts are covered. Reels (including those shared in messages), Stories and Highlights are blocked, and Saved, Liked and Reposted lists are closed.

attributes.text: Opening and browsing TikTok is allowed. The first swipe to the next video in a video feed takes you back, and on Home every top tab other than For You switches back to For You. TikTok has one protection setting, without Strict and Balanced modes.

attributes.text: Home is covered and the Shorts tab is blocked. Search results, channels, playlists, the You tab and long videos remain available.

attributes.text: Subscriptions stay open: they only show channels you chose to follow. You can watch one Short opened from Subscriptions, search, a channel or a link; swiping to the next one takes you back. Reading and scrolling comments do not count as changing videos.

attributes.text: Subscriptions are covered as well. All Shorts are blocked, including those opened from search, channels or links.

attributes.text: Screen information is processed on your device and never sent to a server; a short troubleshooting log stays on the phone only if you turn it on in About. Optional usage-data sharing is a separate choice. App or Android updates can affect detection.
